collection_notes: Steps 4-6 (open-web and T3 press searches) could not be completed for every candidate because the WebSearch budget shared by all agents in this run ran out (searches marked 'blocked' in collection_log were not run); searches that did run produced no items that were used. To keep effort equal, no T3 items are included for any candidate in the US Senate, US House 1-6 or Governor races: every item comes from the T1 voters' pamphlet, official .gov pages or official roll-call pages. Campaign websites are recorded from the pamphlet but were not fetched for positions, for any candidate. oregonlive.com and apnews.com are rejected by the search proxy as allowed_domains and could not be searched for anyone. incumbent=false because the pamphlet edition cited in incumbent_source_url lists another candidate in this race as the sitting officeholder. Pamphlet lists Henry as Progressive, Pacific Green; matches inventory (party Progressive, nominating Progressive + Pacific Green). Step 5 results for 'Chris Henry' concern his 2024 Portland City Council District 4 candidacy (OPB, WW, KATU, KOIN, Mercury); none addressed the 2026 Senate race, so none were used. That he is the same person is not confirmed by an official source.
